## Rule
10×10 ARC grid, colors {0,1,2}. Every hollow 3×3 square of color 1 (`111/101/111`) becomes a
color-2 plus (`010/111/010`) at the same location; all other color-1 cells are preserved.
Output = one-hot `[1,10,30,30]` (only channels 0/1/2, rows/cols 0–9 ever nonzero).

## Algorithm sketch (live packed-row graph)
- Einsum packs each row's **color-1** column occupancy into a 10-bit code (`chan_sel=[0,1,0…]`,
  `col_pow=[1,2,…,512]`) → `rows_f30`→`rows` (uint16).
- Hollow-square detect via u8 shifts/ANDs → `hit8`; two F16 ConvTransposes render the removal
  mask (`W_rem=[7,5,7]`) and the plus (`W_plus=[2,7,2]`).
- Assemble `rowcode10 = out1·1023 + out2·1048575 + 1023` (color-1 bits→10–19, color-2→20–29,
  color-0 = complement), Pad to 30 rows, then `BitwiseAnd(rowcode30[1,1,30,1],
  class_col_bits[1,10,1,30])` decodes to the exempt output.

## Cost analysis
cost 1089 = memory 726 + params 363. **params 363 is at floor** — dominated by the *forced*
`class_col_bits` decoder (300 params; params are dtype-free so a dense 300-elem selector is the
cheapest possible decode operand). Memory is dominated by forced tensors: `rows_f30`(120, F32
Einsum on F32 input) + `rowcode30`(120, uint32 30-bit codes) + assembly (240, six uint32 tensors)
+ `rows_f`/`rows` (60). The decode operand (300) + the two 30-row tensors (240) already = **540 > 500**,
so the prompt's ~500 floor is below the forced components. Full proof + the 9 evaluated
formulations: `hard_records/forced_floor_wall.md`.

## Don't-do log
- **Don't** re-surface / promote the staged **1089** (`objectconvnarrow4drows`, sha `dac4e131`) as a
  "missed LOCAL_GOLD win." It hidden-failed the real stack 2026-07-04 (actual −18.870) despite green
  LOCAL visible/truth-full/AB-full. Live 1094 (Sho) IS the real hidden-passing floor. Any new sub-1094
  packed-row shave off this same family must be treated `PROBE_READY` (x86/Kaggle-confirm), never LOCAL_GOLD.
- **Don't** try to shrink `class_col_bits` below `[1,10,1,30]` — the broadcast to the exempt
  `[1,10,30,30]` output forces channel=10, width=30 = 300 elems; every smaller-storage variant
  (sparse, separable chan⊗col, per-channel unpack) materializes a ≥300-elem intermediate that
  costs MORE than the 300-param initializer.
- **Don't** try `Sum` to fuse the assembly — unsupported on uint32; binary `Add` chain is at floor.
- **Don't** try F16 on the row-pack Einsum — F32 `input` forces F32 output.
- **Don't** replace `Div`+cast with a u8 `BitShift` in detection — u8 truncation drops bit-8 and
  breaks the `adj8[7]` column-8 adjacency test.
- **Don't** go to 2D-plane / Conv-morphology decode — any `[1,·,30,30]` intermediate is ≥900 B.
